subject: Request: LaunchFoundry cohort credits + self-serve issuance
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@launchfoundry.org>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Accelerator credits for LaunchFoundry cohort — LF-2026-0032

Hi Monica,

Hope you're well — LaunchFoundry just closed our Spring 2026 cohort (10 startups) and we'd like to request the cohort credit package we discussed during the partner onboarding. We're requesting: 1) a pool of credits to distribute to cohort startups for up to 3 months, and 2) an optional 30-day trial extension for startups that already claimed the standard PLG credits.

I've attached the acceptance letter and a completed W-9 for our fiscal sponsor. We're ideally looking for self-serve issuance (a claim code or redeemable link we can email to founders) so we don't have to route each activation through partner ops. Can you confirm eligibility and next steps?

Attachments: accelerator_acceptance_letter.pdf (pdf), launchfoundry_w9.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Program Director | LaunchFoundry Accelerator
anna@launchfoundry.org | +1 415-555-0182

P.S. typical use case: infra credits for demos + early prototypes (mostly embeddings/reranking + gen).
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@launchfoundry.org>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator credits for LaunchFoundry cohort — LF-2026-0032

Anna — thanks for the materials and congrats to the cohort! Quick runbook so we're aligned:

- Eligibility: accelerator acceptance letter + fiscal docs are sufficient for the standard cohort grant.
- Distribution: we can either (A) issue a single pool claim code you distribute to founders, or (B) create per-startup allocations (requires roster).
- Trial extension: we can add a 30-day extension to existing PLG claims for founders who already used the free credits; please confirm how many founders need extension.

Next steps I need from you to complete verification (target: 48 business hours):
1) Cohort roster (name, company, contact email) OR a shared Drive link with the roster.
2) Desired allocation model (pool code vs per-startup amounts) and total credit $ amount you want us to allocate.

If you'd like self-serve, we can issue a single redeemable code that expires in 90 days and supports N redemptions. We'll include simple instructions founders can follow (redeem flow + limits).

Looping in Karthik from Partnerships for approvals; Naomi on our Growth Ops side will finalize allocation once verification is complete.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0147

--

We prefer a single redeemable code that each founder can claim individually; if it's helpful, we'd like the pool to be equivalent to $4,000 in credits (so roughly $400 per startup on average) and to include the 30-day trial extension option for founders who already used the PLG credits.

Roster attachment: cohort_roster.csv (contains name/company/email)

Let me know if you need any additional paperwork. If a single code isn't feasible, per-startup allocations are fine — our ops team can share a spreadsheet with allocation amounts.

Best,

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: LaunchFoundry cohort credits + self-serve issuance

Anna — all set. Verification complete (acceptance letter + W-9 + roster). Per your preference we issued a single pool code and pre-allocated $4,000 in credits to deal LF-2026-0032. Details below: 

- Claim code: LFSPRING26-REDEEM (case sensitive)
- Redemption limit: 10 unique redemptions (one per founder)
- Total pool: $4,000 credits; max per redemption: $800; suggested average: $400
- Trial extension: 30 days automatically applied to eligible accounts when they redeem the code (system checks for prior PLG claim history)
- Expiration: 90 days from issuance (2026-06-29)
- Admin view: Credits and redemption logs available to LaunchFoundry via this link: https://app.redwood/incentives/claim/LF-2026-0032 (we granted view-only access to anna@launchfoundry.org)

I've attached a small CSV with the allocation summary and the user-facing redemption instructions that you can paste into your welcome email.

Attachments: credits_allocation.csv (csv), redemption_instructions.pdf (pdf)

If you'd like us to pre-send claim codes to founders as a managed service, we can coordinate that next week (requires signed DPA for direct data handling). Otherwise the single code should be everything you need for self-serve.

Karthik/Naomi — flagging for reporting and to include this grant in the LaunchFoundry partner dashboard.

Thanks — excited to see what these teams build.

Monica Patel
Enterprise Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0147
